classification.resume: This is a television news report from the Swiss Tagesschau series, broadcast on 3 May 1977, showing diplomatic negotiations between Vietnam and the United States in Paris. It features footage of the Vietnamese embassy and the arrival of the US delegation, culminating in a statement by Richard Holbrooke. The report documents a specific moment in Cold War-era international diplomacy.
